At Neogen, we’re right there with you, delivering data-driven solutions and support that put safety at your side.
With an ever-advancing suite of technologies for the food, beverage, animal, and agriculture industries, Neogen helps safeguard your business, your customers, and the world that you nourish.

Neogen offers a wide range of world-class testing solutions to detect indicators, pathogens, allergens, mycotoxins, and more. Trusted by food industry leaders and regulators all around the world, our advanced technologies ensure food product quality and safety at the highest levels. At Neogen, we are committed to preventing foodborne illnesses and safeguarding public health.

Effective solutions for Livestock producers. Designed to fit your needs and support your operation's productivity and growth, our portfolio includes a comprehensive range of instruments and equipment. In addition, Neogen provides cutting-edge genotyping and next generation sequencing solutions for a wide range of animal species including our Igenity® Profiles . Our goal is to help ensure quality and efficiency in your operation.

At Neogen, we are dedicated to improving the lives of pets through our comprehensive portfolio of animal care solutions. We focus on providing innovative products and services tailored to the specific needs of dogs, cats, and horses, ensuring they receive the highest level of care. By equipping pet owners, veterinarians, and industry professionals with a broad portfolio of tools and products, we support pets at every stage of life.

Neogen delivers advanced testing solutions and services tailored to essential industries including Laboratory Testing, Academia & Research, and Immunoassay Production. We support innovation and precision by empowering professionals and organizations with reliable tools such as toxicology and water tests, substrates for immunoassay production, ATP monitoring systems, genomics solutions and more for testing, analysis, and research.

pages.raw_meta: Neogen provides solutions to the food, animal protein and agriculture industries, supporting every link of the world’s food supply chain.
raw_blocks: Neogen® solutions can be found at every step of the food chain

Our comprehensive range of data-driven solutions and services for the food safety and animal health industries help to protect the world’s food supply. We’re also proud to serve the companion and performance animal industries, as well as the fields of life sciences and toxicology.

With this ever-advancing portfolio, we’re made to do more, empowering customers around the world to produce and operate more proactively, efficiently, and confidently than ever before. Together, we can help safeguard your business, your customers, and the world that you nourish.
We make the job easier .
Our data-driven solutions are delivering reliable results quicker, setting new standards for both accuracy and efficiency in the food safety world.
We're made to do more .
Neogen invests in the innovations our customers need to meet the demands of their industry with ease around the world.
Beef , Poultry , Pork
We give you confidence .

We’re right there with you, every step of the way, reducing operational risk and lightening your mental load. We provide unmatched scientific rigor along with pragmatic support and expertise to help safeguard the health of your business.
Find Your Fit Within the Neogen Team:

Scientific innovations blossoming out of Michigan State University needed an avenue to reach the people who could use them to better the world — solutions searching for problems. The university reached out to the men who would become Neogen’s founders, Ted Doan and James Herbert, and soon after, the company was born.

What started as a small team that held organization-wide meetings in a single hallway in Lansing, Michigan expanded into new industries and new states, soon reaching across one ocean, then another. Along the way, our goal solidified: to partner with our customers, farm to fork, to elevate the world’s level of food and animal safety.

Today, we’re achieving that by providing solutions for a vast array of needs all along the food supply chain. It doesn’t matter the business segment, field, or industry — we offer tools our customers use to make their products stronger and safer, while growing their businesses and protecting their brands. We do so across the globe, with a commercial presence in nearly 40 countries.
To partner with our customers, farm to fork, to elevate the world's level of food and animal safety.
Customer support that surpasses expectations

With sound science, we have built the most holistic portfolio in food and animal safety technology. And while we can depend on our science, our customers can depend on our team to provide them the resources needed to help protect their link in the food supply chain, wherever that link may be.

pages.raw_meta: Our experts are always on hand to help with troubleshooting, understanding best practices, offer extra validation testing, and much more.
raw_blocks: Explore Our ISO 17025 Accredited Laboratory Services

We can help you meet all your testing needs with our laboratory services, including complete testing, additional support and specialist help with specific samples, and result verification. Across the globe we have multiple accredited testing laboratories offering a range of services to support your needs.

Our laboratory services offer a range of testing options with flexible turnaround times. We operate to enhance your testing abilities and ensure compliance to your regional and customers’ requirements. More importantly, our testing labs are ISO 17025 accredited, so you can confidently rely on us to properly handle and test your samples while providing fast, accurate results.
Our A2LA and ISO 17025 accredited North American testing laboratory is based in Lansing, MI, and offers a full range of testing options.
Our testing laboratory in Kochi, India is accredited to ISO 17025:2017 as well 17043:2010 by NABL and notified by the FSSAI, Tea board, Drugs controller and PCB of Kerala.
